title: Sam Garg — Frontend Technical Architect
headline: Frontend Technical Architect — Headless Commerce, React/Next.js

summary.p: 15+ years architecting and building e-commerce front-ends for brands like Vans, The North Face, PUMA and Citizen Watches. Most recently the React/PWA Kit front-end architecture for a headless commerce platform on Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Contentful.
I make the composable-vs-built-in call based on size and budget, then design the front-end layer, API boundaries and content models to match.
I still write, review and ship code myself, using Claude Code to move fast while keeping standards, performance and architecture under my own review.
